request: Verify v8 new container post-build and Vault health without changing data or secrets.

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
n=astera-v8
s=$(docker inspect "$n" --format '{{.State.Status}}')
h=$(docker inspect "$n" --format '{{if .State.Health}}{{.State.Health.Status}}{{else}}none{{end}}')
image=$(docker inspect "$n" --format '{{.Image}}')
started=$(docker inspect "$n" --format '{{.State.StartedAt}}')
vault=$(docker inspect libral-vault-libral-vault-1 --format '{{if .State.Health}}{{.State.Health.Status}}{{else}}none{{end}}')
body=$(printf 'V8_POST_DEPLOY_HEALTH_DIAGNOSTIC\nv8_state=%s\nv8_health=%s\nv8_image=%s\nv8_started=%s\nvault_health=%s\n' "$s" "$h" "$image" "$started" "$vault")
gh api -X POST repos/G-ACE-inc/server-core/issues/10/comments -f body="$body" --jq '.html_url'

chat_decision_checkpoint.source_evidence: Docker build/recreate/start succeeded per issue#10 comment6225604759, but health poll failed exit1. Verify exact current health.
